prompt:
This repository is an archive of 160 station operations notes in notes/ (note-001.md .. note-160.md). Three exhaustive identification questions:
1. Which notes report spending exceeding its allocation (a financial overrun), however worded?
2. Which notes report an equipment failure caused by corrosion, however worded?
3. Which notes report wildlife damaging or disrupting equipment or operations, however worded?
Be exhaustive — a missed note is a failure — and exclude near-misses. End your reply with exactly three lines:
ANSWER-OVERRUN: note-xxx, ...
ANSWER-CORROSION: note-xxx, ...
ANSWER-WILDLIFE: note-xxx, ...
